steps.domain_action: Establish the base set of recursive axioms and symbols.
Define the rules of inference for the formal system.
Assign unique Gödel numbers to every symbol and formula.
Compose the numbering scheme into a mapping for proof sequences.
Construct the self-referential predicate that asserts its own lack of a proof-number.
Test the Gödel sentence against the provability predicate.
Attempt to find a proof-number for the sentence within the system.
Recognize the absence of a proof-number for the sentence.
Reconcile the result with the assumption of system consistency.
Hold the sentence as true in the meta-language while unprovable in the object-language.
Record the theorem as a permanent boundary on formal knowledge.
Close the system under the realization of its own incompleteness.
